asked.question: A full joint probability distribution for the Toothache, Cavity and catch world is given below. | | toothache, catch | toothache, ¬catch | ¬toothache, catch | ¬toothache, ¬catch | |---|---|---|---|---| | cavity | 0.108 | 0.012 | 0.072 | 0.008 | | ¬cavity | 0.016 | 0.064 | 0.144 | 0.576 |
Knowledge কী? Human Knowledge কে Computer এ প্রকাশ করার একটি flow diagram দেখান।
What is an expert system? Explain its components.

mustKnow.en: Knowledge representation (KR): formally encoding facts, rules, objects and relations so that a program can reason with them. Main schemes: logic, semantic networks, frames, production rules, scripts, ontologies.
mustKnow.bn: Knowledge representation (KR): fact, rule, object ও সম্পর্ক এমনভাবে formal রূপে প্রকাশ করা যাতে program তা দিয়ে reasoning করতে পারে। প্রধান পদ্ধতি: logic, semantic network, frame, production rule, script, ontology।

mustKnow.en: Types of knowledge: declarative (knowing that), procedural (knowing how), meta-knowledge (about knowledge), heuristic (rules of thumb), structural (relations between concepts).
mustKnow.bn: জ্ঞানের ধরন: declarative (কী তা জানা), procedural (কীভাবে জানা), meta-knowledge (জ্ঞান সম্পর্কে), heuristic (rule of thumb), structural (concept-এর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক)।

mustKnow.en: Properties of a good KR (Rich & Knight): representational adequacy, inferential adequacy, inferential efficiency, acquisitional efficiency.
mustKnow.bn: ভালো KR-এর বৈশিষ্ট্য (Rich ও Knight): representational adequacy, inferential adequacy, inferential efficiency, acquisitional efficiency।

mustKnow.en: Propositional logic: atomic T/F propositions with ¬, ∧, ∨, →, ↔; a formula with n symbols has 2ⁿ truth-table rows; decidable but cannot talk about objects or 'all'.
mustKnow.bn: Propositional logic: ¬, ∧, ∨, →, ↔-সহ atomic T/F proposition; n-symbol formula-র truth table-এ 2ⁿ সারি; decidable কিন্তু object বা 'সব' নিয়ে বলতে পারে না।

mustKnow.en: P → Q is false only when P = T and Q = F; P → Q ≡ ¬P ∨ Q ≡ ¬Q → ¬P (contrapositive). The converse Q → P and inverse ¬P → ¬Q are not equivalent.
mustKnow.bn: P → Q শুধু P = T ও Q = F-এ false; P → Q ≡ ¬P ∨ Q ≡ ¬Q → ¬P (contrapositive)। Converse Q → P ও inverse ¬P → ¬Q equivalent নয়।

mustKnow.en: Inference rules: modus ponens (P, P → Q ⊢ Q), modus tollens (¬Q, P → Q ⊢ ¬P), hypothetical syllogism, disjunctive syllogism, resolution ((P ∨ Q), (¬P ∨ R) ⊢ Q ∨ R).
mustKnow.bn: Inference rule: modus ponens (P, P → Q ⊢ Q), modus tollens (¬Q, P → Q ⊢ ¬P), hypothetical syllogism, disjunctive syllogism, resolution ((P ∨ Q), (¬P ∨ R) ⊢ Q ∨ R)।

mustKnow.en: Tautology/valid = true in every model; contradiction/unsatisfiable = true in none; satisfiable = true in at least one. De Morgan: ¬(P ∧ Q) ≡ ¬P ∨ ¬Q.
mustKnow.bn: Tautology/valid = প্রতিটি model-এ true; contradiction/unsatisfiable = কোনোটিতেই না; satisfiable = অন্তত একটিতে true। De Morgan: ¬(P ∧ Q) ≡ ¬P ∨ ¬Q।

mustKnow.en: First-order (predicate) logic adds constants, variables, functions, predicates and quantifiers ∀, ∃; it is semi-decidable.
mustKnow.bn: First-order (predicate) logic constant, variable, function, predicate ও quantifier ∀, ∃ যোগ করে; এটি semi-decidable।

mustKnow.en: Translation rule: ∀ goes with → (∀x (Student(x) → Smart(x))), ∃ goes with ∧ (∃x (Student(x) ∧ Smart(x))). ¬∀x P(x) ≡ ∃x ¬P(x). Quantifier order matters.
mustKnow.bn: রূপান্তরের নিয়ম: ∀-এর সাথে → (∀x (Student(x) → Smart(x))), ∃-এর সাথে ∧ (∃x (Student(x) ∧ Smart(x)))। ¬∀x P(x) ≡ ∃x ¬P(x)। Quantifier-এর ক্রম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

mustKnow.en: Resolution needs CNF; it is sound and refutation-complete: add ¬goal to the KB and derive the empty clause. First-order resolution uses unification (most general unifier) and Skolemization for ∃.
mustKnow.bn: Resolution-এ CNF লাগে; এটি sound ও refutation-complete: KB-তে ¬goal যোগ করে empty clause বের করতে হয়। First-order resolution unification (most general unifier) ও ∃-এর জন্য Skolemization ব্যবহার করে।

mustKnow.en: Horn clause = at most one positive literal (A ∧ B → C); forward and backward chaining run in linear time on Horn KBs; Prolog programs are Horn clauses answered by backward chaining, depth-first.
mustKnow.bn: Horn clause = সর্বোচ্চ একটি positive literal (A ∧ B → C); Horn KB-তে forward ও backward chaining linear time-এ চলে; Prolog program হলো Horn clause, যার উত্তর depth-first backward chaining দিয়ে।

mustKnow.en: Semantic network (Quillian, 1960s): graph of concepts with labelled arcs (IS-A, HAS-PART); IS-A gives inheritance; the most specific value overrides defaults.
mustKnow.bn: Semantic network (Quillian, ১৯৬০-এর দশক): labelled arc-সহ (IS-A, HAS-PART) concept-এর graph; IS-A inheritance দেয়; সবচেয়ে নির্দিষ্ট মান default-কে override করে।

mustKnow.en: Frame (Minsky, 1974): slot-filler structure for a stereotyped object with defaults, attached procedures (if-needed, if-added) and IS-A inheritance; ancestor of OOP classes.
mustKnow.bn: Frame (Minsky, 1974): আদর্শ বস্তুর জন্য slot-filler কাঠামো, default, যুক্ত procedure (if-needed, if-added) ও IS-A inheritance-সহ; OOP class-এর পূর্বসূরি।

mustKnow.en: Script (Schank & Abelson, 1977): stereotyped event sequence with entry conditions, roles, props, scenes and results (restaurant script).
mustKnow.bn: Script (Schank ও Abelson, 1977): entry condition, role, prop, scene ও result-সহ আদর্শ ঘটনাক্রম (restaurant script)।

mustKnow.en: Production rules: IF-THEN condition-action pairs; production system = rules + working memory + inference engine. Ontology: formal specification of classes, properties and relations (RDF/OWL, Semantic Web, knowledge graphs).
mustKnow.bn: Production rule: IF-THEN condition-action জোড়া; production system = rule + working memory + inference engine। Ontology: class, property ও সম্পর্কের formal বিবরণ (RDF/OWL, Semantic Web, knowledge graph)।

mustKnow.en: Monotonic logic never retracts conclusions; non-monotonic/default reasoning can (Tweety the penguin). Closed-world assumption: what is not known to be true is false (Prolog, databases).
mustKnow.bn: Monotonic logic কখনো সিদ্ধান্ত প্রত্যাহার করে না; non-monotonic/default reasoning করতে পারে (Tweety penguin)। Closed-world assumption: যা সত্য বলে জানা নেই তা false (Prolog, database)।

mustKnow.en: Sound = derives only entailed sentences; complete = derives all entailed sentences. Key KR trade-off: expressivity vs tractability.
mustKnow.bn: Sound = শুধু entailed sentence বের করে; complete = সব entailed sentence বের করে। KR-এর মূল trade-off: expressivity বনাম tractability।

mustKnow.en: Full joint distribution: any probability = sum over the worlds where the event holds; dentist example P(cavity) = 0.2, P(cavity | toothache) = 0.6 (38th BCS).
mustKnow.bn: Full joint distribution: যেকোনো probability = যেসব world-এ event সত্য তাদের যোগফল; dentist উদাহরণে P(cavity) = 0.2, P(cavity | toothache) = 0.6 (38th BCS)।

title.en: Inference from a full joint distribution

formulas.formula: P(φ) = Σ_{ω ⊨ φ} P(ω);  P(a | b) = P(a ∧ b) / P(b)

question.en: Dentist table (cavity: 0.108, 0.012, 0.072, 0.008; ¬cavity: 0.016, 0.064, 0.144, 0.576). Find P(cavity), P(cavity ∨ toothache), P(cavity | toothache).
question.bn: Dentist table (cavity: 0.108, 0.012, 0.072, 0.008; ¬cavity: 0.016, 0.064, 0.144, 0.576)। P(cavity), P(cavity ∨ toothache), P(cavity | toothache) নির্ণয় কর।

question.en: How many rows for 4 variables, and which of Q → P, ¬Q → ¬P equals P → Q?
question.bn: 4টি variable-এ কতটি সারি, এবং Q → P ও ¬Q → ¬P-এর কোনটি P → Q-এর সমান?

working.en: 2⁴ = 16 rows. ¬Q → ¬P matches P → Q in all four (P, Q) rows; Q → P differs when P = F, Q = T and when P = T, Q = F.
working.bn: 2⁴ = 16 সারি। ¬Q → ¬P চারটি (P, Q) সারিতেই P → Q-এর সাথে মেলে; Q → P ভিন্ন হয় P = F, Q = T এবং P = T, Q = F-এ।

formulas.formula: (ℓ ∨ α), (¬ℓ′ ∨ β), θ = MGU(ℓ, ℓ′)  ⊢  (α ∨ β)θ

question.en: Resolve ¬Man(x) ∨ Mortal(x) with ¬Mortal(Socrates), then with Man(Socrates).
question.bn: ¬Man(x) ∨ Mortal(x)-কে ¬Mortal(Socrates) দিয়ে, তারপর Man(Socrates) দিয়ে resolve কর।

working.en: θ = {x/Socrates}: resolvent ¬Man(Socrates). Resolving with Man(Socrates) gives the empty clause, so Mortal(Socrates) is proved.
working.bn: θ = {x/Socrates}: resolvent ¬Man(Socrates)। Man(Socrates)-এর সাথে resolve করলে empty clause আসে, তাই Mortal(Socrates) প্রমাণিত।

traps.en: ∀x (Student(x) ∧ Smart(x)) does not mean 'all students are smart'; it says everything is a smart student. Use → with ∀ and ∧ with ∃.
traps.bn: ∀x (Student(x) ∧ Smart(x)) মানে 'সব ছাত্র বুদ্ধিমান' নয়; এটি বলে সবকিছুই বুদ্ধিমান ছাত্র। ∀-এর সাথে →, ∃-এর সাথে ∧ ব্যবহার কর।

traps.en: P → Q with a false P is TRUE (vacuous truth); the only false row is P = T, Q = F.
traps.bn: P false হলে P → Q TRUE (vacuous truth); একমাত্র false সারি P = T, Q = F।

traps.en: The converse (Q → P) and inverse (¬P → ¬Q) are not equivalent to P → Q; only the contrapositive (¬Q → ¬P) is.
traps.bn: Converse (Q → P) ও inverse (¬P → ¬Q) P → Q-এর equivalent নয়; শুধু contrapositive (¬Q → ¬P)।

traps.en: Resolution proves a goal by refutation: you add the NEGATED goal and derive the empty clause, not the goal itself.
traps.bn: Resolution refutation দিয়ে goal প্রমাণ করে: goal নয়, NEGATED goal যোগ করে empty clause বের করতে হয়।

traps.en: Frames are slot-filler structures (Minsky); scripts are event sequences (Schank); semantic networks are graphs (Quillian). Mixing up 'restaurant script' with a frame is a common MCQ trap.
traps.bn: Frame হলো slot-filler কাঠামো (Minsky); script হলো ঘটনাক্রম (Schank); semantic network হলো graph (Quillian)। 'Restaurant script'-কে frame বলে ফেলা সাধারণ MCQ ফাঁদ।

traps.en: In the 38th BCS dentist question, P(cavity | toothache) = 0.12 / 0.2 = 0.6, not 0.12 (that is the joint P(cavity ∧ toothache)).
traps.bn: 38th BCS dentist প্রশ্নে P(cavity | toothache) = 0.12 / 0.2 = 0.6, 0.12 নয় (সেটি joint P(cavity ∧ toothache))।

traps.en: Classical first-order logic is monotonic and open-world; Prolog's negation as failure is closed-world and non-monotonic.
traps.bn: Classical first-order logic monotonic ও open-world; Prolog-এর negation as failure closed-world ও non-monotonic।

question.en: What is knowledge? Show how human knowledge is represented in a computer (flow diagram), and describe the main KR schemes.
question.bn: Knowledge কী? Human knowledge কীভাবে computer-এ প্রকাশ করা হয় (flow diagram) দেখাও এবং প্রধান KR পদ্ধতিগুলো বর্ণনা কর।

en: Define knowledge (data → information → knowledge) and its types.
Flow diagram: expert → knowledge acquisition → knowledge engineer → representation → knowledge base → inference engine → advice → feedback.
KR schemes with a one-line example each: logic, semantic network, frame, production rule, script, ontology.
Properties of a good KR and one Bangladeshi example (DAE crop advice, bank loan rules).
bn: Knowledge-এর সংজ্ঞা (data → information → knowledge) ও ধরন।
Flow diagram: expert → knowledge acquisition → knowledge engineer → representation → knowledge base → inference engine → পরামর্শ → feedback।
প্রতিটির এক লাইনের উদাহরণসহ KR পদ্ধতি: logic, semantic network, frame, production rule, script, ontology।
ভালো KR-এর বৈশিষ্ট্য ও একটি বাংলাদেশি উদাহরণ (DAE ফসল-পরামর্শ, bank loan rule)।

5.bn: সংজ্ঞা + flow diagram + একটি উদাহরণ (BPSC 5 নম্বর)।

10.en: Add the KR schemes comparison and the four Rich & Knight properties.
10.bn: KR পদ্ধতির তুলনা ও Rich ও Knight-এর চারটি বৈশিষ্ট্য যোগ কর।

question.en: Describe propositional and predicate logic with examples; translate sentences into FOL and prove a goal by resolution.
question.bn: উদাহরণসহ propositional ও predicate logic বর্ণনা কর; বাক্যকে FOL-এ রূপান্তর কর এবং resolution দিয়ে একটি goal প্রমাণ কর।

en: Propositional logic: syntax, truth table of →, inference rules (modus ponens/tollens).
FOL: constants, predicates, functions, ∀/∃; translation rules (∀ with →, ∃ with ∧).
Comparison table (unit, quantifiers, expressiveness, decidability, use).
Worked resolution: CNF steps, clauses, negated goal, unifier, empty clause (Socrates).
bn: Propositional logic: syntax, →-এর truth table, inference rule (modus ponens/tollens)।
FOL: constant, predicate, function, ∀/∃; রূপান্তরের নিয়ম (∀-এর সাথে →, ∃-এর সাথে ∧)।
তুলনা table (একক, quantifier, প্রকাশক্ষমতা, decidability, ব্যবহার)।
হিসাবসহ resolution: CNF ধাপ, clause, negated goal, unifier, empty clause (Socrates)।

5.en: Both logics defined with one example each and a 4-row comparison.
5.bn: প্রতিটির একটি উদাহরণসহ দুটি logic-এর সংজ্ঞা ও 4 সারির তুলনা।

10.en: Add five FOL translations and a full resolution refutation.
10.bn: পাঁচটি FOL রূপান্তর ও একটি পূর্ণ resolution refutation যোগ কর।

20.en: Add CNF conversion of a quantified sentence with Skolemization and forward vs backward chaining on a Horn KB.
20.bn: Skolemization-সহ একটি quantified sentence-এর CNF রূপান্তর এবং Horn KB-তে forward বনাম backward chaining যোগ কর।

question.en: Given a full joint distribution, compute marginal and conditional probabilities (dentist example).
question.bn: Full joint distribution দেওয়া থাকলে marginal ও conditional probability নির্ণয় কর (dentist উদাহরণ)।

en: Marginal: sum the rows/columns where the event holds (P(cavity) = 0.2).
Disjunction: sum all worlds where either holds (0.28).
Conditional: P(a ∧ b)/P(b) (0.6, 0.4); mention normalisation α and the 2ⁿ problem → Bayesian networks.
bn: Marginal: event সত্য এমন সারি/column যোগ (P(cavity) = 0.2)।
Disjunction: যেকোনোটি সত্য এমন সব world যোগ (0.28)।
Conditional: P(a ∧ b)/P(b) (0.6, 0.4); normalisation α ও 2ⁿ সমস্যা → Bayesian network উল্লেখ।

10.en: Add normalisation, independence check and why Bayesian networks are used.
10.bn: Normalisation, independence যাচাই ও কেন Bayesian network ব্যবহার হয় তা যোগ কর।

question.en: What is an expert system? Explain its components and how knowledge (rules, frames) is represented in it.
question.bn: Expert system কী? এর উপাদান এবং এতে জ্ঞান (rule, frame) কীভাবে প্রকাশ করা হয় ব্যাখ্যা কর।

en: Representation: production rules with certainty factors, frames for entities.
Advantages and the knowledge acquisition bottleneck.
bn: Representation: certainty factor-সহ production rule, entity-র জন্য frame।

5.en: Definition + labelled diagram + one rule example.
5.bn: সংজ্ঞা + labelled diagram + একটি rule উদাহরণ।

a.en: Encoding facts, rules and relations in a formal structure (logic, semantic nets, frames, rules) so a computer can reason with them.
a.bn: Fact, rule ও সম্পর্ককে formal কাঠামোয় (logic, semantic net, frame, rule) প্রকাশ করা, যাতে computer তা দিয়ে reasoning করতে পারে।

q.en: Difference between propositional and first-order logic?
q.bn: Propositional ও first-order logic-এর পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: Propositional logic has only whole T/F statements; FOL adds objects, predicates, functions and quantifiers, so it can say 'all' and 'some'.
a.bn: Propositional logic-এ শুধু পূর্ণ T/F বক্তব্য; FOL object, predicate, function ও quantifier যোগ করে, তাই 'সব' ও 'কিছু' বলতে পারে।

a.en: From P and P → Q, infer Q. Its partner, modus tollens: from ¬Q and P → Q, infer ¬P.
a.bn: P ও P → Q থেকে Q সিদ্ধান্ত। এর সঙ্গী modus tollens: ¬Q ও P → Q থেকে ¬P।

a.en: A semantic network is a graph of concepts and relations; a frame is a record of slots and values for one concept with defaults and attached procedures.
a.bn: Semantic network হলো concept ও সম্পর্কের graph; frame হলো একটি concept-এর slot ও মানের record, default ও যুক্ত procedure-সহ।

a.en: A formal, shared specification of the concepts, properties and relations of a domain, e.g. in OWL for the Semantic Web.
a.bn: কোনো domain-এর concept, property ও সম্পর্কের formal, ভাগ করা বিবরণ, যেমন Semantic Web-এর জন্য OWL-এ।

a.en: A formula true under every assignment, e.g. P ∨ ¬P or (P ∧ (P → Q)) → Q.
a.bn: প্রতিটি মান-নির্ধারণে true এমন formula, যেমন P ∨ ¬P বা (P ∧ (P → Q)) → Q।

answer.en: P(cavity) = 0.2; P(cavity ∨ toothache) = 0.28; P(cavity | toothache) = 0.12/0.2 = 0.6; P(¬cavity | toothache) = 0.08/0.2 = 0.4.
answer.bn: P(cavity) = 0.2; P(cavity ∨ toothache) = 0.28; P(cavity | toothache) = 0.12/0.2 = 0.6; P(¬cavity | toothache) = 0.08/0.2 = 0.4।

answer.en: Knowledge = organised information (facts, rules, relations) that supports reasoning. Flow: expert → knowledge acquisition → knowledge engineer → representation (rules/frames/logic) → knowledge base → inference engine → output → feedback.
answer.bn: Knowledge = reasoning-এ সহায়ক সংগঠিত তথ্য (fact, rule, সম্পর্ক)। Flow: expert → knowledge acquisition → knowledge engineer → representation (rule/frame/logic) → knowledge base → inference engine → output → feedback।
